title: Soldiers and officers confirm the giant story to Alberino

tellings.quote: I've interacted with a handful of people um some soldiers, others officers that have confirmed to me that a that story is true and b there are even wilder stories and there are more giants out there than just one obviously.

plain: A handful of soldiers and officers have told Tim Alberino, a guest who says US forces captured a 12-foot giant in Afghanistan, that the story is true. They also told him there are even wilder stories and more giants out there than just the one. Alberino repeats what these people told him without naming them, and if they are right, the giant would not be a one-off.
